lines.en: For four decades, CAD has been built for one thing: a hand on a mouse.
lines.zh: 四十年来，CAD 一直是为一只握着鼠标的手而设计的。

lines.en: But the next engineer at the keyboard isn't a person. It's an agent.
lines.zh: 但下一位坐在键盘前的工程师，不再是人，而是 Agent。

lines.en: And agents don't need a mouse. They need a runtime.
lines.zh: Agent 不需要鼠标。它需要的，是一个运行时。

lines.en: Introducing AgentCAD. The CAD runtime built for AI agents.
lines.zh: AgentCAD，为 AI Agent 打造的 CAD 运行时。

lines.en: Your agent can already write code. Ask it to edit a drawing, and it writes a throwaway script. No undo. No checks. No memory of what changed.
lines.zh: 你的 Agent 已经会写代码。可让它改一张图，它只会写一段用完就扔的脚本：不能撤销，没人检查，下次也不记得改过什么。

lines.en: AgentCAD gives it CAD operations that run as transactions, a journal it can undo from, an independent checker, and eyes on its own work.
lines.zh: AgentCAD 给它的，是按事务执行的 CAD 操作、可以撤销的操作日志、一个独立的检查器，和一双能看见自己作品的眼睛。

lines.en: Describe an apartment in one sentence.
lines.zh: 用一句话，描述一套两居室。

lines.en: The agent lays out walls, doors and windows in a single transaction. And every room is measured from the walls themselves. No area is ever typed in.
lines.zh: Agent 在一个事务里布置好墙、门和窗。每个房间的面积，都由 AgentCAD 根据墙体实测得出，没有一个数字是手填的。

lines.en: Make the master bedroom a metre deeper. The agent moves the wall, and moves the bedroom door too, so the new wall doesn't cut it. The areas follow.
lines.zh: 主卧加深一米。Agent 移动隔墙，还顺手挪开了次卧的门，免得被新墙截断。面积随之更新。

lines.en: Then a brand new session, with no memory of the last one, reads the journal, finds the change, and undoes it.
lines.zh: 然后，一个全新的会话，对上一次一无所知，却能读取操作日志，找到这次修改，并把它撤销。

lines.en: Twelve flanges from one table. The agent checks every row first. Two can't be built: bolt holes past the rim, holes that overlap. It says why.
lines.zh: 一张参数表，十二个法兰。Agent 先逐行检查：有两行根本做不出来，螺栓孔伸出了外圆，孔和孔叠在了一起。它会说明原因。

lines.en: Then it draws the other ten in three seconds. Every one checked on its own.
lines.zh: 然后用三秒画完其余十张，每一张都单独检查。

lines.en: And it speaks AutoCAD. Real DWG files, opened and audited by AutoCAD 2027. Zero errors.
lines.zh: 它也懂 AutoCAD。真实的 DWG 文件，由 AutoCAD 2027 打开并审核：零错误。

lines.en: Same agent, same model. Only the tools change. A five-round revision in four minutes instead of thirteen. Up to one point nine times faster than AutoCAD MCP Pro. Undo across sessions: three for three.
lines.zh: 同一个 Agent，同一个模型，只换工具。五轮改图，四分钟完成，而不是十三分钟。比 AutoCAD MCP Pro 最多快 1.9 倍。跨会话撤销，三次全部成功。

lines.en: Thirty-one out of thirty-one on the AutoCAD MCP benchmark, tied with AutoCAD MCP Pro. And the top score among nine CAD servers on a source-capability review.
lines.zh: AutoCAD MCP 基准测试，31 项全部通过，与 AutoCAD MCP Pro 并列。在九个 CAD 服务的源码能力评审中，得分第一。

lines.en: Open source. Set up in about two minutes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, or any MCP app.
lines.zh: 开源，两分钟左右就能装好。支持 Claude Code、Codex，以及任何 MCP 应用。

lines.en: Your agent can already write code. Now it can draft.
lines.zh: 你的 Agent 已经会写代码。现在，它也会画图了。
